packageRules.description: One PR for all non-major Go module updates; majors stay on their own.
One PR for all workflow action updates, digest re-pins included.
One PR for the mise-managed toolchain. The rules below pull the risky pins back out of this group.
TinyGo compiles the plugin and mvdan.cc/sh is the formatter itself, so both get their own PR and a few days for the release to settle.

Go toolchain, in .config/mise.toml and in go.mod. TinyGo 0.41.x rejects any GOROOT newer than Go 1.26, which fails build-wasm and test-integration. Drop allowedVersions in the same change that pins TinyGo 0.42.0 or later.
